scope: Generic infrastructure readiness, no product or acoustic acceptance

physical_inputs.fluid_model: native constant-property Fluid/LIQUID pure substance, explicitly assigned
physical_inputs.fan_pressure: static; assumed synthetic fixed speed 1000 RPM
physical_inputs.coupling: native geometric solid/fluid interface; verify translator association and heat balance

acceptance.solver_convergence: native flow residual 1e-6 and thermal/coupled change 0.001 C, before 1000 iterations
acceptance.fan_curve_error: max(0.01 Pa,2% expected rise), positive flow inside supplied range
acceptance.effective_materials: verify assigned values and effective solver model; reference values alone do not prove applied density
acceptance.peak_temperature: positive rise above 20 C; no unaccounted heat sink
acceptance.mesh_pair: 2 mm coarse versus 1 mm refinement, same physics; peak rise and flow change <=5%, temperature absolute allowance 0.02 C for small rise
acceptance.limitations: small tetrahedral meshes; infrastructure sanity only, no product accuracy claim
